description: Scheduled token unlocks for ONE coin: the next unlock (date, days until, tokens, USD value, % of market cap, recipients such as team/investors/ecosystem, cliff or monthly tranche), what releases over 30 and 90 days, % unlocked and locked, the final unlock date, the last unlock, and how price moved in the 7 days before and after its last 3-6 unlocks (history, not a forecast). Sources: DropsTab cross-checked with DefiLlama, each figure with its source link and fetch time; `state` says `upcoming`, `fully_unlocked`, `no_unlock_data` or `not_covered` (then `publishedSchedule` may carry the project's own vesting terms). Answers "when is ARB's next unlock?", "who gets the OP unlock?", "how did SUI trade around its unlocks?".

coinId.description: Coin id (e.g. "arbitrum") when a previous result gave it; wins over the ticker when several coins share it.
